description: This file contains implementation of tunable CUDA operations for PyTorch, including classes and functions for managing tuning results, validators, and context, with external dependencies on CUDA and ROCm libraries.

classes.name: TuningResultsManager
classes.description: Manages storage, retrieval, and logging of tuning results and untuned operations.

classes.name: TuningResultsValidator
classes.description: Handles registration and validation of environment and system parameters relevant to tuning.

classes.name: TuningContext
classes.description: Maintains the state and configuration for tuning operations, including file management, environment variables, and validation.

methods.name: getTuningContext
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of TuningContext.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads stream insertion operator for ResultEntry to include optional BLAS signature logging.

methods.name: TuningResultsManager::Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves stored results for a given operation signature.

methods.name: TuningResultsManager::Add
methods.description: Adds a new result entry for a specific operation and parameters.

methods.name: TuningResultsManager::RecordUntuned
methods.description: Records untuned operation signatures to a file.

methods.name: TuningResultsManager::InitRealtimeAppend
methods.description: Initializes real-time logging to a file, writing validators if the file is new.

methods.name: TuningResultsManager::AppendResultLine
methods.description: Appends a result entry to the real-time log file.

methods.name: TuningResultsManager::CloseRealtimeAppend
methods.description: Closes the real-time log file.

methods.name: TuningResultsManager::Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific result entry.

methods.name: TuningResultsValidator::GetAllValidators
methods.description: Returns all registered validators as a map.

methods.name: TuningResultsValidator::ValidateAll
methods.description: Validates a set of environment/system parameters.

methods.name: TuningContext::EnableTunableOp
methods.description: Enables or disables tunable CUDA operations.

methods.name: TuningContext::IsTunableOpEnabled
methods.description: Checks if tunable CUDA operations are enabled.

methods.name: TuningContext::EnableTuning
methods.description: Enables or disables the tuning process.

methods.name: TuningContext::EnableRecordUntuned
methods.description: Enables or disables recording of untuned operations.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetUntunedFile
methods.description: Returns a reference to the untuned operations file stream.

methods.name: TuningContext::EnableNumericsCheck
methods.description: Enables or disables numerical checks.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetNumericalCheckConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current numerical check configuration.

methods.name: TuningContext::SetNumericalCheckConfig
methods.description: Sets numerical check configuration.

methods.name: TuningContext::IsNumericsCheckEnabled
methods.description: Checks if numerical checks are enabled.

methods.name: TuningContext::SetMaxTuningDurationMs
methods.description: Sets maximum tuning duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetMaxTuningDurationMs
methods.description: Retrieves maximum tuning duration.

methods.name: TuningContext::SetMaxTuningIterations
methods.description: Sets maximum tuning iterations.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetMaxTuningIterations
methods.description: Retrieves maximum tuning iterations.

methods.name: TuningContext::SetMaxWarmupDurationMs
methods.description: Sets maximum warmup duration.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetMaxWarmupDurationMs
methods.description: Retrieves maximum warmup duration.

methods.name: TuningContext::SetMaxWarmupIterations
methods.description: Sets maximum warmup iterations.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetMaxWarmupIterations
methods.description: Retrieves maximum warmup iterations.

methods.name: TuningContext::EnableICacheFlush
methods.description: Enables or disables instruction cache flush.

methods.name: TuningContext::IsICacheFlushEnabled
methods.description: Checks if instruction cache flush is enabled.

methods.name: TuningContext::SetRotatingBufferSize
methods.description: Sets size of rotating buffer in MB.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetRotatingBufferSize
methods.description: Retrieves size of rotating buffer in bytes.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetTuningResultsManager
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of TuningResultsManager.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetTuningResultsValidator
methods.description: Returns reference to the validator.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetTuningResults
methods.description: Returns current tuning results and validators.

methods.name: TuningContext::LoadTuningResults
methods.description: Loads tuning results into context after validation.

methods.name: TuningContext::SetFilename
methods.description: Sets filename for results, optionally inserting device ordinal.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetFilename
methods.description: Returns current filename for results.

methods.name: TuningContext::ReadFile
methods.description: Reads tuning results from a file and loads into context.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetLogFilename
methods.description: Returns filename for verbose logging.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetLogLevel
methods.description: Returns current log verbosity level.

methods.name: TuningContext::GetLogOkay
methods.description: Checks if logging is active (not shutting down).

methods.name: TuningContext::GetLog
methods.description: Returns output stream for logging.
